ContactPage.faqListTitle: How do I list my venue?
ContactPage.faqListBody: Contact us at venues@floridaweddingwonders.com with your venue details, photos, and pricing information. We'll review your submission and get your listing live within 2-3 business days.
ContactPage.faqCostTitle: What does it cost to list my venue?
ContactPage.faqCostBody: We offer tiered pricing plans starting from free basic listings to premium featured placements. Contact us for detailed pricing information based on your needs.
ContactPage.faqClaimTitle: How do I claim an existing listing?
ContactPage.faqClaimBody: Find your venue and click "Claim This Listing" or email claims@floridaweddingwonders.com. You'll need to verify your ownership or management role before getting access.
ContactPage.faqUpdateTitle: Can I update my venue information?
ContactPage.faqUpdateBody: Yes! Once you've claimed your listing or created an account, you can update photos, pricing, availability, and all venue details through your dashboard.
